plan.title: Fitness Programme Results
plan.subtitle: Summary of participant growth and performance metrics for donor review

panels.title: Total Participants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Child ID") AS n FROM baseline

panels.title: Avg Height Gain (cm)
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(b."Height cm" - e."Height cm"), 1) AS n FROM baseline AS b JOIN endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Avg Sit-up Gain
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups"), 1) AS n FROM baseline AS b JOIN endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Avg Height Gain by Location
panels.sql: SELECT e."Location", ROUND(AVG(e."Height cm" - b."Height cm"), 1) AS avg_height_gain FROM baseline AS b JOIN endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 Coaches by Sit-up Improvement
panels.sql: SELECT e."Coach", COUNT(DISTINCT e."Child ID") AS children, ROUND(AVG(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups"), 1) AS avg_situp_gain FROM baseline AS b JOIN endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The programme engaged {{p1}} children across multiple locations. On average, participants showed significant physical improvement, with an average height gain of {{p2}} cm and an average increase of {{p3}} sit-ups. Regional performance varied, with the top location achieving an average height gain of {{p4.avg_height_gain}}. Coaching effectiveness was also measured, with the top-performing coach's team showing an average sit-up gain of {{p5.avg_situp_gain}}.
